hero.heading: Capabilities, Awards & Memberships
hero.lede: Core legal and governance competencies, AI literacy, and the professional networks I have built over the years.

cards.title: Law
paragraphs: General legal practice grounded in an LLB from Kings University College and an in-progress LLM in International Law, Security and Diplomacy, covering constitutional, corporate, civil, and international law. This foundation carried through hundreds of legal opinions issued as Legal Affairs Commissioner and now underpins my published SSRN research.
I favour written, reasoned opinions over informal advice, a discipline I built into every legal matter that crossed my desk in student government and continue to apply to business and client matters.

cards.title: Constitutional Law & Legal Advisory
paragraphs: Authored the first amendment to the Kings University College SRC Constitution and its first Standing Orders, and have advised executive, parliamentary, and judicial bodies on constitutional compliance, electoral law, and institutional design.

This advisory experience extends to real, contested matters: opinions on financial-transparency petitions, injunctive relief against a completed transition, and the legal threshold for irregularities in an election count.

cards.title: Corporate Compliance & Statutory Governance
paragraphs: Serve as company secretary or board member across real estate, construction, and legal services firms, managing statutory filings, board communications, and regulatory compliance with Ghana's Registrar General's Department.
This governance discipline also shapes how I run Lawbenpina Ventures, where every import order and business commitment is tracked and followed through in the same structured way.

cards.title: Google AI Professional & Essentials
paragraphs: Google-certified across both the AI Essentials and AI Professional tracks, covering responsible use of AI tools and how to apply them productively in legal and administrative work.

cards.title: Use AI Responsibly & Stay Ahead of the AI Curve
paragraphs: Completed certifications focused on the responsible, ethical use of AI tools and on staying current with fast-moving AI capabilities, relevant to legal-tech and AI-consulting engagements.
